title: Cosmological Data: N-body Simulation Particles, Subhalo, and Void Catalogs
abstract: This dataset provides a sample from a 1 Gpc DEMNUni type N-body cosmological simulation, including particle positions, velocities, and mass. It also includes derived data products from the DeepCosmoNet project: a catalog of identified subhalos with their properties (mass, particle count, centroid) and a complementary catalog of cosmic voids (center position and radius).

provenance.sources: N-body simulation (DEMNUni, 1 Gpc) by Prof. C. Carbone (UniMi, 2024).
provenance.processing: Subhalo and void identification algorithms applied by Koexai Srl (2025) for the DeepCosmoNet project.

structure.conventions: Positions (x, y, z) are in kpc, radii and centers for voids are in mpc. The simulation box spans from 0 to 1,000,000 kpc in each dimension.
